period_note: Half-yearly unaudited consolidated financial statements. Balance sheet is the 30-Jun-2025 snapshot (reported). UNLIKE every other H1 filing in this dataset, this specific report's P&L only prints a 2-column layout (H1'25 cumulative vs H1'24 cumulative) with no discrete-quarter columns at all. Income-statement items below are therefore CALCULATED as H1'25 (reported) minus Q1'25 (reported, this dataset's own 2025_Q1.json) — the same 'two genuine reported cumulative figures, subtracted' method this dataset already uses for every bank's Q4 (Annual minus 9M), not an estimate from annual data. Net profit swings dramatically quarter to quarter: Q1'25 was only 40,590,982; discrete Q2'25 is calculated at 911,518,483, driven by a swing from a tax expense in Q1 to a net tax benefit in Q2 (Provision for Taxation calculated at -231,059,606 for the discrete quarter).

note: Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Equity reconciles exactly. Deposit sub-lines sum exactly to total_deposits. All discrete-quarter income-statement figures are CALCULATED (H1 minus Q1, both independently reported figures) because this specific report's own P&L table only provides 2 columns (H1'25, H1'24), unlike every other year's H1 filing in this dataset which provides a 4-column layout including discrete-quarter figures directly. Internal consistency confirmed: PBT-before-provision discrete (2,226,769,112 minus 882,847,190 = 1,343,921,922) minus discrete total provision (663,463,045) = discrete PBT (680,458,877) exactly; discrete PBT minus discrete tax (calculated as a net benefit of -231,059,606, i.e. Provision for Taxation H1'25 217,571,879 minus Q1'25 448,631,485) = discrete net profit (911,518,483) exactly.
